description:
The trend of a machine's health score over time from rows you supply: slope, when it would
        cross the warning level, and how strong the evidence is. Makes no remaining-useful-life
        promise it cannot support.
        Example: analyze_health_trend(rows=[{"timestamp_s": 0, "health": 0.95, "quality": "good"}, {"timestamp_s": 3600, "health": 0.9, "quality": "good"}, ...], warning=0.5).

min_points.description: Fewest rows needed before a trend is reported.
min_points.title: Min Points

rows.description: Health rows you supply, each {"timestamp_s": seconds, "health": 0 to 1, "quality": "good"}, oldest first (rows not good are skipped).
rows.title: Rows

warning.description: Health below which the trend is a warning, 0 to 1.
warning.title: Warning

name: analyze_health_trend
title: Analyze a machine health trend
